article.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Smashes Microsoft Store Records Ahead of November Launch
article.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI launches on consoles and via XBOX Cloud Gaming on November 19, following record-breaking pre-order numbers.
article.body:
Grand Theft Auto VI has secured its place as the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store. This unprecedented demand arrives just before the game’s official release, with Rockstar Games confirming that pre-loading for the highly anticipated title is already underway as of November 10. Players are encouraged to initiate their downloads early to ensure they are fully prepared for the launch day experience.

For many, this news means the game is more accessible than previously anticipated. The expansion into XBOX Cloud Gaming ensures that owners of older hardware, such as the XBOX One, can still participate in the launch on day one. By leveraging cloud technology, the experience will utilize XBOX Series S graphics settings, allowing a broader range of players to access the title on consoles they currently own without needing to upgrade to the latest generation of hardware.

According to official reports from XBOX Wire, the cloud streaming service for the game will officially go live at 1am ET on November 19. Furthermore, starting November 11, users in supported markets will have the option to purchase individual cloud playtime for specific titles without the requirement of a monthly Game Pass subscription. This change aims to accommodate the massive interest surrounding the latest release from Rockstar Games.

While the focus remains on the November 19 launch, XBOX has confirmed plans to expand its Rockstar Games library on the cloud platform in the coming months. Players can expect titles like Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2 to be added to the streaming service as part of a broader push to increase accessibility across the XBOX ecosystem.

article.headline: Irish unions suspend nationwide public sector strike after securing major pay deal
article.summary: Trade unions have called off a nationwide strike planned for November 12 after reaching a new 10.75% pay agreement with the government.
article.body:
The breakthrough came at 3.30am at the Workplace Relations Commission, preventing a 24-hour stoppage that would have crippled schools, health services, and government offices during the upcoming European Political Community summit. With the strike suspended, over 300,000 workers who participated in earlier industrial action will now wait to review the full details of the proposal before casting their votes in a national ballot.

This deal carries a total cost of €5.2 billion to be spread across five national budgets. The agreement is designed to specifically protect those on the lowest incomes, who could see their total pay increase by as much as 18.3% over the lifetime of the contract. Public Expenditure Minister Jack Chambers described the settlement as a balanced and sustainable measure that prioritizes lower-paid staff while remaining within the government's fiscal parameters.

Under the terms reached, pay will rise by 10.75% over a period of two years and nine months, running from July 2026 to March 2029. The deal includes several phased adjustments, with the first significant pay increase scheduled for September 2026. The agreement also raises the threshold for lower-pay provisions from €50,000 to €60,000, ensuring a broader base of workers benefits from the new minimum payment protections.

National executives of the affiliated unions are scheduled to meet in the coming days to formally analyze the document. Following this assessment, they will provide a recommendation to their membership, setting the stage for a national ballot to confirm the final acceptance of the new terms.

news.title: سياحة وترفيه / أمير منطقة الجوف يدشّن حديقتَي خوعاء وعذفاء بتكلفة 4.1 ملايين ريال
news.og_title: سياحة وترفيه / أمير منطقة الجوف يدشّن حديقتَي خوعاء وعذفاء بتكلفة 4.1 ملايين ريال
news.og_desc:
صوير 30 جمادى الأولى 1448 هـ الموافق 10 نوفمبر 2026 م واس
    دشّن صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير فيصل بن نواف بن عبدالعزيز أمير منطقة الجوف اليوم، حديقتين بمركزَي خوعاء وعذفاء، بتكلفة إجمالية بلغت 4,100,000 ريال.
    وشمل المشروعان إنشاء حديقة بمركز خوعاء على مساحة 15,500 متر مربع، بتكلفة 1.8 مليون ريال، وحديقة بمركز عذفاء على مساحة 17,800 متر مربع، بتكلفة 2.3 مليون ريال.
    وتضمنت أعمال تهيئة الحديقتين إنشاء مسطحات خضراء وزراعة عدد من الأشجار، وتجهيز مسارات للدراجات الهوائية وإنارة الموقعين، بما يعزز جاذبيتهما ويهيئهما للتنزه وممارسة الأنشطة الرياضية.
    وأكد سمو أمير منطقة الجوف أن ما تشهده محافظات المنطقة ومراكزها من مشروعات تنموية وخدمية يأتي امتدادًا لاهتمام القيادة الرشيدة -أيدها الله- بالمواطن أينما كان، وحرصها على أن تشمل التنمية مختلف أنحاء المنطقة وتنعكس آثارها على حياة الأهالي.
    ويأتي تدشين الحديقتين ضمن جهود أمانة المنطقة لتطوير الحدائق والمساحات العامة وتحسين المشهد الحضري، بما يواكب مستهدفات رؤية السعودية 2030.
    // انتهى //
